meta.description: Semantic layer — exact definitions of every displayed metric. The dashboard and the AI layer must cite these definitions.
meta.disclosure: Synthetic hospital dataset (984 patients, disclosed). Demo analytics — NOT intended for diagnosis, treatment, or clinical decision-making.

patients.definition: Count of patient records in the current filter scope.

readmission_rate.definition: Share of patients with Readmission = Yes.

readmission_cost_burden.definition: Cost held by readmitted patients — the operational headline.
readmission_cost_burden.caveat: Association, not causation: readmitted patients are costlier, the data does not prove readmission causes the cost.

outcome.caveat: No patient died in this synthetic dataset — a generation property, disclosed.

fairness.definition: Model fairness audit of the readmission model (scripts/fairness_check.py).
fairness.reading: Tiny AUC gaps do not mean fairness: the dataset's readmission base rate differs sharply by gender. Parity in one metric is not fairness.

model_honesty.definition: Audit of the headline model metric (scripts/model_honesty_audit.py).
model_honesty.reading: AUC ~0.99 is a property of the synthetic generation process (readmission is nearly deterministic given Condition), not predictive skill.

cohort_shap.definition: Cohort-level SHAP attribution of the readmission model (scripts/cohort_shap_analysis.py).
